ownership_rules.scaffold_exception: H00 may create empty package entrypoints and shared tooling under apps/learning_hub; root records the exact initial files and transfers future edits to their registered owner. No feature implementation under another owner's path.
ownership_rules.canonical_exception: H09 proposes an exact canonical patch; root explicitly assigns that maintained-source path set after the H02 schema/compatibility gate. No canonical changes before that recorded assignment.
ownership_rules.shared_composition: H00 composition hooks and shared configs remain foundation-owned; root routes registration/interface edits to foundation, never competing worker edits.

roles.responsibility: Coordinate dependency receipts, integration, release and narrowly reviewed interface changes.
Own backend models, schema, migrations, storage/receipt foundation and generated API types.
Own supported Plus OAuth, Codex RPC/process adapter, model access and usage transport.
Own typed app shell, course/section/assessment/review UI, Agents tab and accessibility.
Own safe deterministic visual components, equation registry and accessible reference-case validation.
Own source inventory/extraction, durable jobs, owner adapters, checked preparation and publication.
Own deterministic grading, prepared-rubric AI assessment, exposure-aware selection and course-specific reviews.
Own manual launcher, process supervision, backup/restore, diagnostics and user runbooks.
Own cross-feature end-to-end/fault/security verification, fixtures and release evidence; route product fixes to owner.
Independently review exact integrated commits for correctness, trust boundaries, evidence safety and release completeness.

tasks.title: Scaffold and locked quality tooling
steps: Read package; record supported runtime/dependency versions. Create Python package with backend package-dir and React/TS frontend; lock dependencies and document baseline. No production fake content.
Create composition entry point and health route, typed Clock/IDs and test transports, feature namespaces, temporary-vault fixtures and private/runtime ignore rules scoped to app.
Create Makefile targets check-unit, check-contracts, check-integration, check-ui, check-e2e, check-all, build, export-contracts, launch and stop; targets must invoke real tools and propagate failure.
Establish Ruff, one static Python type checker, pytest, ESLint/TS strict, component tests and Playwright. Cross-language API types generated, not hand-copied.
Produce initial development README and install diagnostic. Shared scaffold edit ownership transfers explicitly to later role owners.
acceptance: Fresh checkout install/build works with documented locked dependencies.
Health serves loopback and no course/learner records are fabricated.
Deliberately failing check exits nonzero; no catch-all disabled tests.
App runtime secrets/database/temp outputs are ignored without ignoring canonical journals.

tasks.title: Prove supported Plus sign-in and provider adapter
steps: Implement ProviderClient against supported SIWC registration/sign-in. Validate state/nonce/PKCE, redirect origin and ID token/scopes. Persist opaque host/client IDs and credentials in protected local storage.
Implement length-bounded newline JSON-RPC stdio framing, initialize/initialized handshake, thread start/resume, turn start/cancel and terminal event mapping. Pin compatible app-server binary/version.
Implement account-specific model/effort access verification, redacted provider events, refresh/restart/resume and typed error taxonomy. Do not equate model catalog with access.
Perform one real subscribed inference with explicit model+effort after user sign-in. No browser cookie scraping, backend-api routes, API key fallback or purchased credits.
Return supported/unsupported capabilities to core and worker. Store receipt without tokens; pause unavailable eligibility rather than retry endlessly.
acceptance: Mock OAuth wrong state/nonce/redirect/expired token rejected; secrets absent from UI/logs.
Real terminal completed request proves selected subscription access; revoked login remains blocked.
Interrupted/failed turn never marked successful; fragmented RPC/events handled.
Auth refresh resumes correct thread without duplicating a logical task.

tasks.title: Typed contracts and compatibility gate
steps: Implement CONTRACTS canonical models (strict/discriminated unions, ID/version types, allowed states) and public/private serialization.
Create SQLite migrations/constraints, repository protocols and generated OpenAPI/TypeScript types. Add proposed web bundle/evidence extension schemas only after compatibility review.

Write exact migration proposal for current records contract: legacy prefix preservation, schema3 immutable event acceptance, appended web facts, owner fields/validation. Root assigns canonical patches in H09.
Generate controlled illustrative synthetic bundles/questions and contract fixtures. No ingestion readiness or learner outcome inferred from fixtures.
Freeze API version v1/schema revision; root reviews exported interface before dependent tasks merge it.
acceptance: Unknown fields/invalid version tuple/dangling question IDs rejected.
Private keys and retention items excluded from learner payload snapshot tests.
Upgrade from existing legacy/schema3 fixtures preserves byte-identical prior events.
Generated TS matches OpenAPI; migration empty/upgrade/conflict tests pass.

tasks.title: Durable receipts, owner evidence and projections
steps: Implement receipt command boundary and request hash uniqueness, actual timestamps, pending outbox and response replay. Server creates attempt/item/version identity.
Checkpoint prepared prompt through teach owner before delivery; store display acknowledgement separately. Actual raw answer persisted before AI dispatch.
EvidenceWriter commits compatible teach-owned transaction and verifies bytes/journal; only then marks outbox acknowledged and rebuilds projections. H09 supplies production owner runtime capability.
Handle crash cuts before/after canonical commit and DB acknowledgement with stable event/transaction IDs and recovery inspection. Preserve unsaved pending intent.
Expose catalog/session/resume/readiness and receipt endpoints with legal transitions. Completion derives from received process facts; result pending/absent is not fail/pass.
acceptance: Repeated same key/body replays; different body returns conflict.
Crash after canonical write replays without a duplicate event; uncertain journal blocks projection.
85%-style status projection never rewrites objective acquisition evidence.
Refresh/second tab/version conflict preserves exact attempt and learner response.

tasks.title: Typed UI shell, courses/weeks and upload surface
steps: Port design reference into modular shared tokens/layout/semantic components and generated API client.
Implement routes, full identity catalog, week/lesson lists, truthful readiness/completion/attention badges and empty/pending/error states.
Replace localStorage course/lesson counters; expose no manual completion UI/mutation.
Build course/week upload picker/dropzone and per-file states using contract fake transport until H07 is integrated; mocks only in development/tests.
Implement responsive navigation and provider/health status view, preserve keyboard/focus and error retry behavior.
acceptance: All published weeks accessible without score locks.
Partial coverage denominator is explicit; missing evidence shows unknown.
Desktop/narrow/empty/error screenshots inspected; no demo statistics.
Upload saved state is distinguishable from ingested/published state.

tasks.title: Section lesson player, maths and deterministic checkpoint UI
steps: Implement structured section renderer and pinned lesson sessions; navigation/heading IDs come from bundle contract.
Implement active outline IntersectionObserver with reduced-motion behavior and accessible scroll/focus handling.
Render sanitized prose, maths, source assets, worked steps and generic visuals. Validate supported math and no arbitrary HTML.
Implement numeric/matching/choice question inputs, receipt lifecycle, prepared feedback/correction flow, assistance and resume bookmark.
Implement separate prepared quiz/test/review UI states; final assessment/selection services from H11/H12 integrate through unchanged contracts.
acceptance: Scrolling/navigation alone never verifies completion.
Wrong/correct feedback displayed after persisted response and repeat submits are idempotent.
New publication mid-session cannot swap key/content; reload resumes outstanding item.
Long maths/headings/reduced motion/keyboard matching supported.

tasks.title: Validated interactive visual component library
steps: Implement versioned safe visual registry and typed configurations for timeline, relationship/payoff plots, scenario table, derivation reveal and annotations.
Use controlled numeric functions; declare units/domains/assumptions/reference cases. Never eval arbitrary generated expressions/scripts.
Coordinate required model/schema additions through foundation; align public rendering and backend publication validators.
Provide keyboard controls, semantic text/table alternatives and bounded parameter input.
Prepare synthetic reference fixtures with checked numerical cases; actual course instances await academic review.
acceptance: Invalid parameter/domain/formula config is rejected, not rendered as credible content.
Reference cases below/at/above strike and bond domain examples pass when supported.
Interactions do not fabricate mastery; accessibility alternatives work.
No component introduces a new course topic without finished-note support.

tasks.title: Uploads, stable source revisions and previous-week delta inventory
steps: Persist staged bytes durably, inspect actual media type/size, sanitize path and assign stable source ID/course/week; preserve immutable revisions.
Implement managed-source and primary 00_Materials same-course scans on upload/startup plus debounced watcher; hash bytes/record relevant dependencies.
Handle duplicate/replacement/rename/deletion explicitly; never delete notes/evidence due to file removal.
Coalesce batches into source snapshot, mark affected dependency scope and create durable requested job using H08 repository port.
Implement local extraction/render/OCR adapter inventory with page/slide locator and failure coverage. Preserve figures/tables/maths.
acceptance: Identical upload triggers no extra AI step; earlier-week bytes change is detected.
Traversal/symlink/type mismatch/oversize rejected; original revisions preserved.
Unreadable page remains unresolved; partial extraction cannot certify coverage.
Rename-only delta preserves identity and missing-file conflict does not delete learner records.

tasks.title: Durable worker, quota recovery and serialized course reservations
steps: Implement job/step transition graph, atomic leases/fencing, heartbeats, expired worker recovery and input/output fingerprinted checkpoints.
Serialize course owner mutations across checkout roots with configured global coordinator reservation and existing local records lock; do not steal active locks.
Handle quota eligibility with reported reset time or bounded unknown-reset probes; distinguish auth/permanent/input/provider-transient errors.
Yield safely for pause/cancel and interactive grading priority, release course locks while waiting. Persist every next eligible run time.
Expose job reads/events/legal commands, retention-safe cleanup and dependency invalidation; no in-memory-only FastAPI background queue.
acceptance: Browser closure does not stop worker and restart recovers exact eligible pending step.
Crash/expired lease cannot allow stale worker publish or duplicate canonical write.
Unknown reset is not assumed 5h; low-frequency probes do not rerun full job.
Cancelled/paused/limit-wait job releases locks and preserves staged artifacts.

tasks.title: Canonical owner-contract support and bounded Uni runtime adapters
steps: Have root explicitly serialize and assign the canonical extension patch proposed by H02. Scope exact maintained records/templates/validators and generated package checks, no installed cache edits or private plugin release.
Implement strict SkillRunRequest/Result with selected absolute vault root, full course/source scope, transaction/review IDs, allowed owned tools and compatibility.
Dispatch existing Uni owners and separate reviewers with fixed model/effort and no competing writers; required source reviews use originals, curriculum reviews use checked notes.
Bridge deterministic web facts to teach logical ownership without LLM per checkpoint and without unsupported current schema fields; verify owner transaction.
Support plan/ingest repair and exhausted-item-bank handoffs, pending intent recovery and source approvals inside site. Return blockers honestly.
outputs: canonical-extension patch explicitly assigned by root
acceptance: Legacy/schema3 fixture bytes/events unchanged through migration and replay.
Tools cannot target another checkout, source text cannot expand permission, wrong owner rejected.
No ready plan or completed ingestion if independent review absent/material findings remain.
Grade/journal failure leaves answer pending; no fabricated source/learner evidence.

tasks.title: Checked ingestion/planning pipeline and atomic publication
steps: Implement snapshot->ingest review->plan review->structural/transaction/Git gate->export->publish DAG with coverage matrix.
Prepare 25min sections, checkpoints/all-option feedback, sample-assessment-inspired keys/variants/visual specs via canonical plan owner.
Verify input revision and dependency fingerprints before each handoff; superseded job cannot publish against newer sources.
Stage public/private bundle/assets, validate schema/links/math/visuals/required content/versions, fsync then atomically publish pointer.
Freeze active sessions, preserve previous definitions/evidence and derive compatibility/delta routes. Queue noncritical notification until lesson end.
acceptance: Every required finished-note concept maps to taught/assessed objective or remains an explicit blocked gap.
Fault between staging/pointer leaves complete old or new bundle, never mixed files.
Unreviewed/stale/partial academic output or repository integration blocker cannot publish Ready.
Changed criterion does not regrade old attempts or reset course progress.

tasks.title: Prepared quizzes, scoring and short-answer assessment
steps: Implement deterministic exact-choice/matching/numeric grading using prepared tolerances/units with Decimal-safe parsing.
Implement prepared quiz sessions and weekly blueprint50/50 points, current/historical scope rules, no repeated exposed independent questions.
Implement short-answer grader bounded to exact rubric/version and actual response; validate structured component result; escalate ambiguous supported cases to Sol/high runtime assessor.
Separate submitted/completed/graded/passed/attention/unscorable and essential criteria. <90 attention, >=80+essentials pass; existing acquisition rules remain separate.
Support immediate retry variants, delayed classification and feedback only after canonical result committed. Slow/limit-limited grade remains pending while other study continues.
acceptance: 85%+essentials: pass+attention;95% with missing essential: no pass.
Malformed/ambiguous AI score can't commit, invent new rubric or turn missing answer into fail.
Numeric rounding/decimal-v-percent/tolerance cases explicitly tested.
Weekly50/50 score weight and Week1 exception tested; original/assisted/retry results remain separate.

tasks.title: Exposure-aware course-specific review and recommendation adaptation
steps: Implement selection from prechecked unseen banks using item and family relation/exposure metadata; option shuffle alone never fresh.
Implement recall-owned evidence replay/date/gates via existing deterministic policy, no AI arithmetic or invented acquisition.
Implement corrective refresh vs retention pre-recap routes, estimates based on included topics, no fixed duration cap and no score locks.
Derive per-course Needs attention queues and adaptive next-study recommendations without rewriting canonical requirements.
Trigger background plan bank extension when variants exhausted; incoming checked version reconciles exact compatibilities/reassessment.
acceptance: Review session never mixes courses; weak-topic reason/evidence visible.
Fresh retrieval shown before recap; exposed/too-early/unknown-condition answer cannot become delayed retention.
Unseen bank exhaustion queues checked preparation rather than repeats marked fresh.
Recall updates derived only from committed results; retries/pending grades don't fabricate schedule evidence.

tasks.title: Agents UI and role/model controls
steps: Implement resumable job timeline/events, source/review/publication details and changed-lesson summaries.
Display requested/actual model+effort and known usage/reset separately, never guessed cost/ETA.
Implement legal pause/resume/cancel/retry and future-job role settings through backend; validate supported choices.
Use post-lesson information queue, no progress toasts while reading; credential/private-reasoning redaction.
Exercise restart/reconnect/cursor gap states against integrated worker, not mock-only production behavior.
acceptance: SSE duplicate/gap handled via event dedup/resnapshot.
Unknown usage shown unknown, reviews not falsely labelled approved.
Changing role config cannot alter running attempt/key/rubric or disable required academic checks.
Browser lesson uninterrupted by routine publication jobs.

tasks.title: Manual launcher, supervision, diagnostics and backup/restore
steps: Implement installed local CLI and double-click launcher, single-instance lock/health discovery, detached supervisor and explicit stop.
Bind only loopback, enforce allowed origin/local mutation session, keep secrets in protected store and runtime outside Git.
Implement graceful shutdown, child cleanup, quota/sleep/restart recovery, log rotation and redacted diagnostic output.
Implement consistent operational DB+canonical records/bundles backup with manifest and restore into isolated directory; verify pending intents/version links.
Write setup/start/stop/update/troubleshooting/restore runbooks; no login autostart or machine waking.
acceptance: Manual launch->browser close->worker continues; explicit stop->launch resumes safely.
Existing unrelated port process never killed and no wildcard origin exposure.
Restore preserves attempts/history/pending outbox/private assets; invalid backup fails safely.
Launcher usable by learner without opening terminal/Obsidian.

tasks.title: Integrated behavioral, security and recovery QA
steps: Build end-to-end Playwright and fault matrices in VALIDATION against exact integrated SHA with fake provider/temporary isolated vault.
Test origin/path/auth/secret/answer-key boundaries, concurrent tabs/workers, upload versions, journal crashes and publication pointer cuts.
Verify all agreed learner flows and responsive/math/visual accessibility screenshots; route bugs to owners, do not patch their modules.
Run repository before/after issue identity comparison, records fixture suite, all app check/build targets and migrations/restore.
Produce redacted release evidence and unresolved issues; no claim academic fact check from engineering tests.
acceptance: Every V01–V16 acceptance case mapped to actual result; material failures block release.
Injected loss/duplication/version/quota cases pass without fake grades or lost evidence.
Native displayed UI inspected with long/empty/pending/error scenarios.
No production fixture authority, skipped critical checks or secret in bundle/log.

tasks.title: Independent review, bounded real pilot and completed release
steps: Have fresh hub_reviewer inspect exact candidate SHA, security/data/role/Git boundaries, task receipts and acceptance evidence. Repair/recheck all material findings.

Prove supported real account integration and one bounded permissioned real-course upload->independent source check->independent plan check->publication->lesson UI flow. Do not fabricate a learner answer to populate dashboard.
If learner assessment behavior needs real answers, use isolated fictional rehearsal tagged test-only; record pilot limits and validate real app response plumbing without inventing evidence.
Open/update protected PR, verify exact head/checks, record ready_for_merge, merge/read back remote main, sync clean primary and preserve role branches/needed artifacts.
Deliver working manual launcher, runbook and final scope/checks/limits/commit/merge refs. If external source/signin/review gate fails, preserve work and report blocker, not finished app.
acceptance: All prior task acceptance validated on exact integrated SHA and reviewed final content.
Real source/curriculum reviewers report exact scope/final result; no inferred learner mastery.
Launcher and complete upload-to-study flow work with verified subscription access.
Actual PR merge/main sync/branch provenance confirmed.
